desc: Non-stacking: Upon taking MDMG, you have a 1% chance to negate the incoming damage. Effect CD: 10 seconds.
Non-stacking: When receiving attacks, there is a 2% chance of performing Assumptio Lv.2 on yourself. No CD.
Non-stacking: Your skill attacks has a 1% chance to gain [Skill DMG +10%] (CD: 15 sec).
Non-stacking: Upon releasing a skill, there is a 5% chance of increasing Healing Done by 5% for 10 seconds. Effect CD: 15 seconds.
Taking PDMG has a 5% chance to restore 5% HP (CD: 30 sec). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
Taking PDMG has a 5% chance to reflect 20% DMG (CD: 30 sec). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
Taking PDMG has a 5% chance to PDEF +5%, lasting 3 seconds (CD: 10 sec). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
Non-stacking: There is a 3% chance to increases PDMG/MDMG by 3% for 3 seconds when attacking. No CD.
When dealing Non-Status MDMG, there is a 12% chance to double the next non-status DMG. (CD: 0.5 sec) Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
Upon taking damage, there‘s a 30% chance to inflict [MSPD -3%] on the attacker for 3 sec, up to 10 stacks. Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
Neutral Skill DMG +5%; Non-stacking: Dealing Non-Status DMG has a 30% chance to inflict [Severe Wound] status, and reduce target's Healing Done and Healing Taken by 30% for 3 seconds.
PDMG Reduction +10%, MDMG Reduction +10%. Non-stacking: When taking PDMG, 20% of the DMG is reflected back to the attacker. (CD: 0.5 sec)
Upon taking damage, there’s a 10% chance to reduce All Element Skill DMG by -3% on the attacker, lasts 3s. (Up to 5 stacks) Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
Your attacks have a 3% chance to break enemies‘ Armor for 2 sec (CD: 10 sec). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.

MATK has a 5% chance to auto-cast Magic Bombardment, dealing 50% Earth MDMG to up to 30 enemies within 4-meter radius and lowering MSPD by 30% for all enemies within range for 3 sec. (CD: 10s) Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
Non-stacking: When taking damage, 10% chance to restore 10% Max HP and gain PDMG/MDMG Reduction +40% for 5s. (CD: 10s)

Non-stacking: Each hit you take has a 10% chance to grant one stack of [Tidal Ward], increasing PDMG/MDMG Reduction and Healing Taken by 4% per stack for 60 sec, up to 7 stacks. At 7 stacks, your attack inflicts a 4-sec [Immobilize] on the target, and all [Tidal Ward] will be removed, granting you [PDMG/MDMG Reduction +15%] for 5 sec and preventing gaining [Tidal Ward] for the next 15 sec.

Non-stacking: Your attacks have a 15% chance to inflict a 8-sec [Ember Fury] on enemies (CD: 3 sec). If the enemy casts skills during [Ember Fury], reduces their Max HP by 3% for 5 seconds (CD: 2 sec). This effect does not apply to bosses or MVPs.

Upon hitting an enemy with a physical skill , there‘s a 20% chance to enter the [Core Eruption] state for 6 seconds. Effects: PDMG +7%; ASPD +10%; Cooldown: 12s. This effect does not stack, but its duration can be refreshed.

When a magic skill hits an enemy, there is a 20% chance to enter the [Void Resonance] for 6 seconds. During this state, MDMG is increased by 7%, and SP Consumption is reduced by 10%. Cooldown: 12s. This effect does not stack and will only refresh its duration.

When attacking, there is a 2% chance to inflict Stun on the target for 2.5s. The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it‘s active. (CD: 3.5s) The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.

When attacking, there is a 2% chance to inflict Blind on the target for 5s. The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it‘s active. (CD: 7s) The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.

When attacking, there is a 5% chance to inflict Frozen on the target for 6 sec. (CD: 8s) The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it’s active. The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.
Normal attacks have a 10% chance to trigger a two-staged strike, and the generated normal attacks cannot be converted into other skills (CD: 0.3 sec). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.

When attacking, there is a 2% chance to inflict Curse on the target for 30s. The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it‘s active. (CD: 38s) The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.

When attacking, there is a 5% chance to inflict Fear on the target for 5 sec. (CD: 7s) The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it’s active. The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.

When attacking, there is a 2% chance to inflict Stun on the target for 2.5s. The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it‘s active. (CD: 3.5s) The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.

When attacking, there is a 5% chance to inflict Sleep on the target for 30 sec. (CD: 38s) The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it’s active. The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.

When attacking, there is a 2% chance to inflict Poisoned on the target for 10s. The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it‘s active. (CD: 13s) The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.

When attacking, there is a 5% chance to inflict Silence on the target for 5 sec. (CD: 7s) The same target cannot be affected by this debuff again while it’s active. The trigger chance stacks when multiple cards are equipped.

When attacking, there‘s a 5% chance to restore your HP equal to 15% of the DMG dealt to the enemy (Maximum cannot exceed 10 times the player's highest PATK/MATK) CD: 0.5s. Accumulates trigger chances from cards.

When attacking, there‘s an 8% chance of reducing the target's SP by 5% of their Max SP (up to 30 points for normal attacks and 50 points for skill attacks). CD: 0.5 sec. Accumulates trigger chances from cards.

Upon using PATK, you have a 8% chance to auto cast Bowling Bash Lv.1. (CD: 0.5 sec) If you have learned this skill, you auto cast the highest level you've learned instead. Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
PATKs have a 8% chance to auto-cast Thunderstorm Lv.5 (CD: 0.5 sec). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
PATK has a 4% chance to auto-cast Slash Lv.1 (CD: 0.8 sec). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
When dealing physical attacks, there is a 5% chance to auto-castHeal Lv.5. internal CD 3s. Trigger chance stacks with multiple cards.

When dealing physical attacks, there is a 5% chance to auto-cast Toy Bombardment, dealing 50% physical damage to up to 5 targets within a 4-meter range, while reducing the movement speed of enemies in the bombardment area by 30%. The effect lasts for 3 seconds. This effect has a 10-second cooldown. Trigger chance stacks with multiple cards.
PATKs have a 5% chance to auto-cast Raid Lv.5 (No CD). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
Your attacks have a 20% chance to auto-cast Dragon Breath Lv.10 (CD: 2 sec). Chance to trigger stacks with multiple cards (up to a max trigger rate of 60%).
Your attacks have a 5% chance to auto-cast Heaven's Drive Lv.3 (CD: 2 sec). If you have learned this skill, you auto cast the highest level learned. Accumulates trigger chances from cards.

Your attacks have a 5% chance to auto-cast Water Ball Lv.10 (CD: 1 sec). Accumulates trigger chances from cards.
